detail: The customs house as its own site — separated from the asset store. It answers the trade's two questions and nothing else: 1. Is the thing as its manifest says? — entry, weigh, strike, search. 2. What is the thing allowed to do on the road? — rate, band, seal. It is where R6 SHIP lives: the crate — the bounding box — is demanded here because everything downstream (rate, band, seal, clearance) is arithmetic on the box. No box, no clearance.
note: The customs house is a site with a specific function: inspection and clearance. It is not the store — the store stores, the customs clears.
